test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can separately complete a work in 20, 25 and 30 days, respectively. If A works on the first day alone, B on second day alone and C on the third day alone, and this sequence goes on further, in how many days will the entire work be finished?
solution:
Given:

A can do the work in 20 days

B can do the work in 25 days

C can do the work in 30 days

Formula used:

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ 1/Efficiency

Calculation:

1st day work by A = 1/20

2ⁿd day work by B = 1/25

3rd day work by C = 1/30

Work completed in 3 days

⇒ 1/20 + 1/25 + 1/30

⇒ (15 + 12 + 10)/300 = 37/300

Time taken to complete the work

⇒ 3 × 8 = (37/300) × 8

⇒ 24 days = 296/300

The remaining work to be finished by A, the next day = (4/300)/(1/20) days.

⇒ 24 (4/15)

The entire work be finished in 24(4/15) days.
